text: Ask the player about their most recent relationship status — 3 questions minimum.
The group votes on the player's most likely personality flaw — then each player defends their vote.
Each player asks one question the selected player must answer truthfully — no passing.
Group agrees on one word to describe the player and says it simultaneously — player has to react.
Ask the player to rank everyone in the room from most to least trustworthy — out loud.
Group asks the player about their love life — 3 questions, any topic.
Ask the player what they genuinely think of each person in the room — one sentence per person.
Group interrogates the player about the last time they did something they shouldn't have.
Ask the player 3 'what would you do if...' scenarios — group rates the answers.
Group chooses a life decision the player has made and questions them about it for 60 seconds.
